purpose: Define exactly how threshold-free factor hypotheses may advance to combination research before the canonical V2.8.1 factor screen is run.

research_population.layer: U official Certified Mother Pool technical research
research_population.note: Stage-1 tests generic technical information content on the official universe. Passing does not create AI-Core E-layer eligibility.

reason_exploratory_only: These have either ambiguous/nonlinear expected shape, stronger anti-chase interaction risk, or execution rather than standalone-alpha interpretation. Observing them cannot promote them in V2.8.1.

outcomes.endpoint_vintage_rule: D and T endpoints from the same T-vintage retained snapshot

daily_cross_section_method.rank_ic: Spearman correlation between factor and forward economic return within each signal date.
daily_cross_section_method.spread: direction-adjusted Q5 minus Q1 mean forward economic return within signal date.

minimum_data_quality: evaluation begins only after each feature's required warmup is available
factor valid on at least 80% of eligible evaluation dates after warmup
median valid-security coverage at least 70% of that date's official research universe
a calendar quarter must contain at least 20 valid evaluation dates to count as a stability block
statistical_promotion_requires_all: direction-adjusted mean daily D+10 Rank-IC is positive
95% moving/date-block bootstrap confidence interval for mean daily D+10 Rank-IC excludes zero in the hypothesized direction
Holm-Bonferroni familywise correction at alpha=0.05 across all nine promotion-eligible hypotheses passes
direction-adjusted mean daily D+10 Q5-Q1 spread is positive
95% date-block bootstrap confidence interval for D+10 Q5-Q1 spread excludes zero in the hypothesized direction
D+10 mean Rank-IC has the hypothesized sign in at least two-thirds of valid calendar-quarter blocks
leave-one-valid-quarter-out mean D+10 Rank-IC retains the hypothesized sign for every omission
secondary D+5 mean Rank-IC has the same hypothesized sign
anti_optional_stopping: all nine promotion-eligible factors are evaluated in one frozen run
failed factors remain in the result ledger
no factor may be removed from multiplicity correction after seeing its result
new transforms or directions require V2.8.1+1 preregistration and a new result ledger
promotion_effect: PASS advances the individual factor to Stage-2 combination research only. It does not define a Setup, emit an Episode, certify profitability, or authorize live trading.
